directAnswer: To change the default browser in Windows, go to Settings > Apps > Default apps, then select your preferred web browser under the 'Web browser' section.
summary: Changing the default web browser in Windows is a straightforward process that can enhance your browsing experience.

sections.heading: Understanding Default Apps
sections.body: Default apps in Windows determine which programs open specific types of files and links. Setting a default browser means that all web links will open in your chosen browser.

sections.heading: Windows Version Variations
sections.body: The steps to change the default browser may vary slightly depending on your version of Windows. The instructions provided are primarily for Windows 10 and Windows 11.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.detail: Click on the Start menu and select the gear icon to open Settings.

steps.title: Navigate to Default Apps
steps.detail: In the Settings window, click on 'Apps', then select 'Default apps' from the left sidebar.

steps.title: Select Your Browser
steps.detail: Scroll down to the 'Web browser' section, click on the current default browser, and choose your desired browser from the list.

steps.title: Confirm Changes
steps.detail: Once selected, close the Settings window. Your changes will take effect immediately.

faqs.question: Can I set a different browser for specific links?
faqs.answer: Windows does not support setting different default browsers for specific links; all web links will open in the default browser you selected.

faqs.question: What if my preferred browser is not listed?
faqs.answer: If your preferred browser is not listed, ensure it is installed correctly. You may need to reinstall it or check for updates.

faqs.question: Will changing my default browser affect my bookmarks?
faqs.answer: No, changing your default browser does not affect your bookmarks; they remain in the browser you are switching from.

caveats: Some applications may still open links in their own embedded browser regardless of your default browser setting.
